text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is reporting on the results of the traffic calming poll undertaken on Hanson Street, between Coxwell Avenue and Hillingdon Avenue. The poll provided a response rate of less than the 50 percent plus one ballot required by the traffic calming policy needed to confirm that there is a favourable consensus in the community to install speed humps on the subject section of Hanson Street. Accordingly, continuing the process to install speed humps on Hanson Street, between Coxwell Avenue and Hillingdon Avenue is not recommended.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. The City Solicitor prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install three speed humps on Hanson Street, between Coxwell Avenue and Hillingdon Avenue, generally as shown on Drawing No. 421G-2961, dated April 2018 attached to the report (June 14, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
